description:
“I learned… from books. After all, I am a prince.”

Hyoun felt hot again.  
A handsome dragon prince as if carved from jade was on her lower abdomen.  
Anyone who sees her rubbing her forehead like a puppy will do so.

"ah……."  
“But now I think I’m glad I took that class. I learned how to cherish Jeongin.”

*

Hyo-un, who lives in her male attire, picks up her snails while farming.  
It turns out that this snail,  
Although he was the son of the Dragon King of the West Sea, he ran away from home.

They say that you can only live if people on land accept you.  
I cook well and do housework well!  
Even the beauty is amazing!

How easy would it be to meet such a beauty? Ah, not this.  
Shall I accept it first?

“You have to pretend to be my wife.”  
"yes?"  
“So, you have to be dressed as a woman.”  
“I… do you mean me? Why?”  
“Because I need it.”
